about: What bb tool sound say and hear run: piper turns text into speech, and whisper turns a recording back into text with its times. About 800 MB.
label: Speech in and out (piper, whisper)
name: audio

run:
dst="$2"; mkdir -p "$dst/bin" "$dst/libexec" "$dst/models/voices" "$dst/models/whisper"; rm -rf "$dst"/.work.* 2>/dev/null || true; t="$(mktemp -d "$dst/.work.XXXXXX")"; tar -xzf "$1" -C "$t"; cp "$(find "$t" -name uv -type f | head -1)" "$dst/libexec/uv"; chmod +x "$dst/libexec/uv"; rm -rf "$dst/python" "$dst/venv"; export UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="$dst/python" UV_CACHE_DIR="$t/cache" UV_NO_CONFIG=1 UV_LINK_MODE=copy HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1; "$dst/libexec/uv" venv -q --python 3.12 "$dst/venv"; "$dst/libexec/uv" pip install -q --python "$dst/venv/bin/python" piper-tts faster-whisper "av<16"; "$dst/venv/bin/python" -m piper.download_voices --download-dir "$dst/models/voices" en_US-ljspeech-medium; "$dst/venv/bin/python" -c "import sys; from faster_whisper import download_model; download_model('base.en', output_dir=sys.argv[1])" "$dst/models/whisper/base.en"; ln -sf ../venv/bin/piper "$dst/bin/piper"; printf '#!/bin/sh
here="$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")"
exec "$here/../venv/bin/python" "$@"
' > "$dst/bin/python-audio"; chmod +x "$dst/bin/python-audio"; rm -rf "$t" 2>/dev/null || true
verify: import piper, faster_whisper; print('piper and faster-whisper', faster_whisper.__version__)

terms.label: the ljspeech voice, trained on the public-domain LJ Speech dataset
